connector.name: Codecov
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for querying Codecov coverage data with configurable URL support
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server-codecov. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the egulatee account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CODECOV_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL for self-hosted Codecov instances (optional, defaults to https://codecov.io)
